outcome: Δ hemoglobin (difference between prepartum and postpartum Hb)
Stillbirth rate after 26 weeks of gestation
cohort: 348 women with ICP and 15,083 controls who delivered between 2004 and 2014
finding: In women with treated ICP and planned delivery at 38 weeks, postpartum blood loss was not significantly different compared to controls, although meconium staining was more frequent in moderate and severe ICP.
